commands.ping: Checks that I am awake and how fast I answer.
commands.help: Lists what I can do, or explains a module or command.
commands.prefix: Shows the prefix, or changes it for this community.
commands.about: Who I am and how I am doing.
commands.vote: Vote for Maxwell on fluxerlist and unlock every locked module for you.
commands.mydata: Sends you everything Maxwell stores about you in this community.
commands.forgetme: Deletes your levels, currency, cards and other data in this community.
commands.afk: Marks you as away. Mentions of you get your note until you write again.

prefix.tooLong: Keep it to 8 characters or fewer.

about.tagline: I keep things in order around here.

entropy: Entropy here: low. Keep it that way.

vote.done: Your vote is in. Locked modules are open for you in the dashboard.
vote.ask: Vote for Maxwell on fluxerlist once and every locked module opens for you.{link}

greet.hello: Hi, I'm Maxwell. I keep things in order around here.
greet.mention: Mention me any time you forget the prefix.
greet.missing: > I'm missing **{permission}**, so {feature} won't work yet.

afk.set: {hasReason, select, yes {You are away: {reason}} other {You are away.}}
afk.back: Welcome back. You were away for {duration}.
afk.away: {hasReason, select, yes {{who} went away {since}: {reason}} other {{who} went away {since}.}}

privacy.exported: Everything I store about you in that community.
privacy.nothingStored: I store nothing about you in that community.
privacy.noDm: I can't DM you. Open your DMs and try again.
privacy.warning: This deletes your levels, currency, cards, notes and everything else I keep about you here. Moderation cases stay.
privacy.confirm: React with {emoji} or run `{prefix}forgetme confirm` to go ahead.
privacy.partial: Most of it is gone. {modules} failed, try again later.
